posts.name: Pradheepa
posts.cooked:
Could you please clarify the BPT2 Score? It should be more than 50 marks.

my test cases passed 100%for BPT2_problem_1,problem2.

Two out of four passed for Problem3 and Problem 4. But the score shows only 50 ?Kindly clarify.

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked: Only if all test cases pass for a question then you will get marks for it otherwise no. All the test cases are public so you check where you are making a mistake.

posts.name: Pradheepa
posts.cooked: Then what is the score for passed test cases ? Some score should be added for passed test cases .

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked:
If you have passed all 4 test cases you get full marks
If you pass 1/4, 2/4 or 3/4 test cases you get 0 for that. Partial marks are not there.

posts.name: Pradheepa
posts.cooked: But test case pass is a pass even if it is 1

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked:
You can refer to this

Partial Marking in BPT System Commands
We are not giving partial marks for BPT. We are giving either 0 or 100—100 if all the test cases pass, otherwise, 0.

posts.name: Pradheepa
posts.cooked: thank you ma’am. I am finding difficult to clear OPPE for SC from last term . That’s why I was worried.

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked:
OPPE has partial marking as it has private test cases. So, you will get marks based on the number of private test cases passed in OPPE.

Also, I would suggest start practicing for OPPE from now. Keep a target of practicing 2-3 hrs/week (if you have other courses & commitments) the more versed you are with the terminal and the commands, the better you will perform.

posts.name: Pradheepa
posts.cooked: Thank you for the feedback. Will start practising
